newsitem.title: NORWAY: Bullish Norway bourse hits another life peak.
newsitem.headline: Bullish Norway bourse hits another life peak.

text.p: Norwegian shares, buoyed by strong European and American stock markets, surged to the 16th record close this month in brisk trade on Friday.
But dealers said market sentiment was uncertain after January's rally.
Oslo's Total share index closed 0.6 percent higher at 1,067.19 points. Turnover was 1.25 billion crowns.
Gains were made across the board with the banking and industry indexes leading the way. The shipping and insurance indexes posted more modest rises.
Norsk Hydro, Norway's largest listed company and with a 20-percent weighting on the Total index, rose 1.10 percent to 366 crowns.
Food-based conglomerate Orkla's B share closed 2.42 percent higher at 465 crowns.
Another winner was DnB, Norway's top commercial bank, which shot up 3.09 percent to 26.70 crowns. Christiania Bank, the second biggest commercial bank, finished 1.83 percent higher at 22.20 crowns.
